caption:
Monday's Sky is Yang Wood, The Great Tree 🌳 Find your element below.

Your element is the element of the day you were born. Today's tall tree meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yang Wood gets a friend day, Yang Water gets a joy day, Yang Earth feels the pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

How's your Monday going? Comment your element below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #mondaymotivation #fiveelements #chineseastrology #horoscope #bazi #personalgrowth #worklife #singapore
day_line: A great tree on a Horse day. Tall and full of energy: good for fresh starts and getting moving, easy to rush.

lines.Yang Wood: Your crowd has Monday energy today. Split the big task and race to lunch.
lines.Yin Wood: Someone talks louder in the meeting today. Speak once, clearly; it's enough.
lines.Yang Fire: Ideas come fast this morning. Write three down before the emails start.
lines.Yin Fire: A colleague covers for you today. Return the favour by Friday.
lines.Yang Earth: Monday pushes hard today. Guard your lunch hour; you'll need it.
lines.Yin Earth: Your steady work gets a nod today. Accept the praise; don't downplay it.
lines.Yang Metal: A new task has your name on it today. Take it if it teaches you something.
lines.Yin Metal: Check the subscriptions today. Cancel the one you forgot you had.
lines.Yang Water: Monday flows easy for you today. Share the good mood in the group chat.
lines.Yin Water: Your voice matters in today's meeting. Bring one clear suggestion.
